item.title: Using tmux
item.author: paul@insightsforaction.uk (Paul Hewson)
item.description:
Photo by Sergei Starostin, Pexels

tmux Cheat Sheet

I can never quite remember the routine for setting up a long running job on a server using nohup, more specifically the 2>&1 routine to divert output into a log file i.e. nohup run something log.log 2>&1 &. Which sounds trivial, but I’ve had a few prompts to start using tmux.
